column1: # Block 16 additions — the small combatants that actually fill the Baltic.
# The block began with capital ships and one landing ship, which is what a
# reader meets in a photograph of a parade and not what they meet at sea. These
# All beam or near-beam views with the whole hull in frame, chosen over sharper
# photographs that were dressed overall or moored among other warships: bunting
# and a neighbouring hull cost more than a little softness.
